sourceRecords.title: Principle Power Wins O&M Contract for EFGL Floating Foundations
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that Principle Power was awarded the O&M support contract for the 30 MW EFGL project in the French Mediterranean. The source states the scope covers integrated O&M services for three WindFloat foundations, including inspection, maintenance and repair, remote monitoring, data analytics and engineering support.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review. Not counted as a reconstructed weekly candidate because basic FOWT/offshore-wind relevance was not supported by the stored title/evidence text.

sourceRecords.title: Experimental Floating Axis Wind Turbine installed in a bay of Iki City, Nagasaki
sourceRecords.sourceText: Sumitomo Heavy Industries announced that the FAWT Consortium installed an experimental Floating Axis Wind Turbine in Iki City, Nagasaki, with offshore demonstration beginning in July 2026.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review. Not counted as a reconstructed weekly candidate because basic FOWT/offshore-wind relevance was not supported by the stored title/evidence text.

sourceRecords.title: Ocean Winds reaches full power from its first floating offshore wind project in France
sourceRecords.sourceText: Ocean Winds announced that the 30 MW EFGL floating wind farm reached full power, with three 10 MW turbines on semi-submersible floaters off the Occitanie coast.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: Flylogix to conduct surveys for planned Scotland wind facility
sourceRecords.sourceText: Wind Systems Magazine reported that Flylogix will carry out digital aerial surveys for the proposed Moray FLOW-Park, a temporary wet storage facility for floating offshore wind foundations.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: Celtic Sea Developers Form Floating Wind Forum
sourceRecords.sourceText: Offshore Engineer reported that Celtic Sea floating wind developers formed a forum to coordinate skills, supply chain, investment, environmental protection, and social value across projects.
